title: Batch & Cache Cost Optimizer: Regression Sentry and Safe Rollforward
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Objective: Build a Regression Sentry + Safe Rollforward capability that automatically vets batching and KV-cache recommendations for cost savings, ensuring measurable output-quality parity before any production config changes are applied. The system should enable an automated, reversible progressive apply (rollforward) instead of blunt immediate rewrites, with clear statistical acceptance criteria and runbooked escalation paths.

Background: We have multiple autotune and advisor systems proposing batching and cache parameter changes that reduce per-token cost substantially. Existing guardrails focus on pullbacks and canary metrics but lack a unified statistical validator that ties cost recommendations to prompt-level quality regressions across representative workloads. This ticket scopes the engineering work to implement a service-level evaluation harness (Regression Sentry), the acceptance/threshold logic, and the orchestration primitives for safe progressive rollforward and automated rollback triggers.

Scope:
- Implement the Sentry evaluation job that runs proposed config changes in shadow mode across three workload slices: Golden prompts (hand-curated anchors), high-frequency production traces (sampled), and synthetically broadened prompts (fuzzed inputs).
- Define and implement a small, extensible set of quality metrics: semantic-similarity (embedding cosine with anchor outputs), normalized token-level divergence, response latency percentiles, and task-specific pass rates (when applicable).
- Statistical decision engine: two-sided non-parametric tests (Wilcoxon / bootstrap CI) for median/mean shifts and configurable alpha thresholds; compute effect sizes and business-impact-adjusted delta.
- Orchestration: progressive rollforward policy (shadow -> 1% traffic -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%) with automatic hold and rollback triggers; ensure safe concurrency with Dedicated pools.
- Observability: per-config diff dashboards, per-prompt regression tables, and automated alerting to oncall with summarized evidence (examples of regressions and confidence intervals).
- Runbook and playbooks for manual review, fast rollback, and postmortem triggers.

Out of scope: full evaluator for multimodal models and new model architecture kernel selection logic.

Deliverables:
- Regression Sentry service (k8s job + airflow orchestration prototype) and libraries for metric computation.
- Acceptance threshold config format and default policies.
- Rollforward orchestrator that integrates with Runtime rollout APIs and Console rollouts.
- Dashboards and alerting rules and an oncall playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Regression Sentry can run proposed batching/cache config in shadow against a representative workload within the runtime staging environment and produce a regression report JSON.
Decision engine outputs a single pass/fail recommendation plus numerical deltas (effect size, p-value, CI) per metric and per workload slice.
Rollforward orchestrator can advance a config through staged traffic increments with automatic pause and rollback when configured triggers are met.
Operational dashboards show per-config token-cost delta, latency P95 delta, and a top-10 prompt regression sample within 10 minutes of Sentry completion.
Oncall can trigger manual rollback with a single button from Console and receive a machine-generated incident template with key evidence.
End-to-end test (see test_plan) passes in CI with synthetic golden prompt set and a simulated production trace dataset.
plan:
Phase 1 (2 sprints): design metrics & acceptance format, implement local Sentry runner, integrate with existing autotune proposals API. Phase 2 (2 sprints): implement decision engine (bootstrap CI + effect size), wire progressive rollforward orchestrator to runtime, and add shadow-run plumbing. Phase 3 (1 sprint): dashboards, alerts, and runbook; internal dogfood on a subset of customers; iterate on thresholds.

Key tasks:
- schema: proposal -> sentry-run manifest (who/what/when/traffic-slices)
- implement sentinel job in python using existing eval harness (reuse eval libs)
- compute metrics: embedding-similarity (use embeddings-service), token-divergence (KL-like normalized measure), latency deltas
- decision engine: bootstrap CI with configurable alpha (default 0.01 for P1 changes, 0.05 for P2), minimum sample sizes
- orchestrator: integrate with rollout API, implement safe stepper and pause/rollback signals

Owners: Priya (owner for metrics + decision), Liam (orchestrator + runtime integration), SRE (observability + alerting).
test_plan:
Unit tests for metric calculation and decision logic. Integration test in CI that runs a full Sentry pipeline against a deterministic fixture: 200 golden prompts, 1k sampled traces, and 2k fuzzed inputs; inject a controlled regression on 5% of golden prompts to verify rollback trigger. Load test: ensure Sentry job for a single proposal completes within 30 minutes in staging. Canary test: dogfood on internal staging customer for two weeks.

Acceptance test: create an autotune recommendation, run Sentry, verify pass/fail matches injected ground truth, then exercise rollforward steps via orchestrator in an isolated runtime.
rollout_strategy:
Default policy: shadow run + automated evaluation. If pass -> rollforward with steps: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 48 hours with automated evaluation at each step. If any step has a metric exceeding configured tolerances (e.g., semantic-similarity drop > 0.04 with p-value < 0.01 or latency P95 regression > 20%), orchestrator pauses and triggers oncall. Manual override allowed with explicit acknowledgment and documented justification. Rollback path: immediate rollback to previous config; orchestrator records finger-print and reason.

Emergency rollback: if the SLOs degrade > 3x for more than 5 minutes, orchestrator performs immediate rollback.
monitoring: Metrics emitted for each Sentry run: run_id, proposal_id, sample_counts, per-metric delta, p-values, effect_size. Dashboards: Sentry Overview (run throughput, median runtime, pass rate), Recent Regressions (top prompts with diffs), Traffic Rollforward Status (per-config progress). Alerts: Sentry-fail (on pass rate drop > 10% of recent baseline), Rollforward-pause (on any step pause), Emergency-rollback (on SLO breach). All alerts include links to regression report and example input/outputs.
